🔥 Join Team Sl-Pyronix! 🚀

We're tackling NASA Space Apps Colombo's “Flame in Freefall” challenge!

Our mission is to use AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science to analyze fire behavior in microgravity and improve space safety.

🔍 We're looking for: UI/UX designers, web developers, data analysts, creative thinkers, and space enthusiasts.

🌟 Join us to innovate, collaborate, and compete for global recognition!

🔥 Let's innovate beyond gravity! 🚀
